inputs.shared_method: quant_research/entry_autopsy.py (imported: entry definition, clock pinning, 13 indicators, matched controls, Holm)

volume_attribution.note: a pair means minute i carries +x and minute i+1 carries -x, so the day's total volume is unchanged and only the minute assignment of a block of trades differs; the repo's klines come from the raw trade stream while this rebuild uses aggTrade rows (one timestamp per aggregated block)

timezone_evidence.why: all 50 funding rows read 03:00/11:00/19:00, so the CSV clock is 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC shifted by +3h (mod 8h the candidates are -5h, +3h and +11h; only the phase is pinned). +3h is adopted because the commit author timezone of this repository is +0300 and neither -5h nor +11h is a plausible account timezone for this ledger. Both the +3h and the +0h readings are nevertheless computed end to end and reported.

check_no_nan_in_null.note: a non-finite null mean means a drawn control bar carried NaN; the pools are built so this cannot happen

definitions.bar: 15s bucket stamped T covers [T, T + 15s); open/high/low/close are first/max/min/last traded price, volume is summed base quantity
definitions.as_of: last 15s bucket stamped floor(entry_utc,'15s') - 15s, i.e. the last bucket that had closed strictly before the entry
definitions.print_bucket: b = as-of index + 1, the bucket the print landed in
definitions.print_minute_first_bucket: m0 = the first 15s bucket of the minute containing b

forward_references.why: minute-anchored so the four references are the same tradeable instants as the 1m autopsy's, making the two blocks directly comparable

definitions.intra_15s_adverse_print: side * (fill / open[b] - 1) * 1e4 - the part of the adverse print that happened INSIDE the 15s bucket the trade printed in; the 1m run could only measure the whole minute
definitions.post_print_path_bps: side * (close[b + k] / fill - 1) * 1e4 for k = 0..3; the key `print_bucket_start+15s(k+1)` is the close of the (k+1)-th bucket after the print's own bucket, so elapsed time since the actual print is 0-15s LESS than the key says
definitions.control: same as entry_autopsy.py, drawn from 15s bars
definitions.multiple_testing: Holm within family (13 indicators; 4 horizons per reference)

execution.definition: side * (actual fill price / reference - 1) * 1e4; positive means the print was WORSE than the reference in the direction of the trade
